nodes.description: Every reported variant changes Pro65, in an N-terminal loop adjacent to the RING domain. Structural modelling and molecular dynamics predict that the substitution alters this loop and destabilizes the protein, and the loop is proposed to contact histones. Absence of truncating variants or deletions in patients argues against simple haploinsufficiency; a dominant-negative effect is proposed but untested.
